objective: To monitor the price data from eCatalogue per Logistic Partner (Trucking Company): Fix Cost (Monthly Price) and Mileage (Price per KM).
To show the validity of each price (Active, Expired, Future / Not Yet Active) from its effective period.
To provide the price reference used when PR Monthly is generated. The screen is read only; prices are maintained in eCatalogue.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Title 'Pricing Data', breadcrumb 'Master - Pricing Data' (menu Master > Price).
Filter Section: Periode = 'Select Month', Trucking Company = 'Select Trucking Company', Component = 'Select Component', Status = 'All Status'.
Pricing Data List shows all price data, sorted by Periode descending, Mileage before Fix Cost, then Trucking Company; 10 rows per page. No data: message no. 1.
The screen is read only: no Add, Edit, Delete or Upload. Prices are maintained in eCatalogue (MP-01).
5.2 Filter Criteria
Periode: month picker (YYYYMM). A price is shown when its effective period overlaps the month: Effective Start <= last day of month AND Effective End >= first day of month (MP-08).
Trucking Company: active companies of Master Trucking Company, 'Code - Name', searchable by code or name; only listed values can be selected.
Component: Fix Cost (Monthly Price) = FIX, Mileage (Price per KM) = KM.
Status: Active / Expired / Future, compared with the calculated status (5.4).
All criteria are optional and combined with AND. Blank criteria are not applied.
5.3 Search / Cancel

items: Click Search: read the criteria, disable Search and show the loading indicator.
Select from Price Master with Periode, Trucking Company and Component; calculate Status per row and apply the Status filter.
Sort (5.1 c), show page 1 and 'Showing n to m of x entries'. No row: message no. 2.
Click Cancel: clear all criteria and the Search box, reset to the initial display (all data, page 1).

operation.text: 5.4 Status Determination (MP-02)
Status is calculated from the effective period and the server date (today); it is not stored.
Example (today 2026-10-30): 202610 = Active, 202608 = Expired, 202612 = Future / Not Yet Active.
5.5 Keyword Search, Table View, Export
Search box filters the current result immediately on all visible values and the trucking company name; no match: message no. 3.

Table View shows / hides columns. Default visible: Periode, Trucking Company, Component, Price, Effective Start, Effective End, Status, Created By, Created Dt, Changed By, Changed Dt. Default hidden: Vehicle Type, Source.
Export .xls exports all filtered rows (all pages) with the visible columns to 'Pricing_Data_YYYYMMDD.xls'; Price is exported as a number; message no. 5.
5.6 Paging
Rows per page 10 / 25 / 50; changing it returns to page 1.
« first, ‹ previous, page numbers (max 5), › next, » last. First / previous disabled on page 1; next / last disabled on the last page.
5.7 Price Display
Price is shown as a number with thousand separator and no unit (e.g. 2,700 and 28,500,000).
Meaning by component: Fix Cost = IDR per month (SPK GAD: vehicle + driver rental for one month); Mileage = IDR per KM (vehicle maintenance cost x actual KM).
5.8 PR Monthly Price Lookup (MP-03 to MP-06)
PR Monthly uses the price of the partner + component (+ vehicle type) whose effective period covers the whole production month.

items: No price: message no. 7; PR not generated for that partner / component.
Only expired price: message no. 8; expired prices are never used for a new PR Monthly.
More than one valid price: message no. 9 (data error).
Exactly one valid price: used in PR Monthly. Mileage cost = Price per KM x actual KM (Master Mileage).

operation.text: Behaviour when the price changes after the PR was created: TBD (OP-06).
5.9 Data Source, Security and Audit
Data is synchronised from eCatalogue (Created By = SYSTEM). Schedule and new / changed / deleted handling: TBD in a UISS-Batch (OP-05).
Access follows the existing role framework (View / Export Pricing Data, TBD).
Audit fields shown: Created By, Created Dt, Changed By, Changed Dt.
Database Specification (ELIPS AE070_ILS_DB)

Source of truth for tables / columns / types: docs/db/ELIPS_Schema.sql. No sample data was available: value lists and status codes are TBD. Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Conflict = code / UISS rule not supported by the table; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts (UISS / code vs ELIPS schema) - application not changed

items: G-MPR-01 Price component: UISS / code: FIX / KM components. DB: No component column in MS_ROUTE_PRICE. Recommendation: Confirm component identification (material code?)
G-MPR-02 Period: UISS / code: Periode YYYYMM column. DB: Only VALID_DT_FROM / VALID_DT_TO. Recommendation: Derive period from validity dates
